visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair and pinkish-purple highlights is seated in a brightly lit office studio. She is wearing a cream-colored oversized sweatshirt. She holds a smartphone toward the camera, showing a photo of herself with colorful retro Japanese stickers and text overlays. (2) The camera zooms in on the smartphone screen. A hand scrolls through a Google search result page for the term 'heisei-puri'. (3) The screen transitions to a website with a vibrant pink and purple interface, featuring large 'START' buttons and retro-style pixel art icons. A finger interacts with the screen to begin a process. (4) The interface mimics a physical sticker photo machine (Purikura), showing options for different time-period styles like '1990s' and '2000s'. The user selects a frame with pink hearts and 'in Shibuya' text. (5) The girl holds the phone up to take a selfie. She makes a peace sign with her hand as the screen captures the image. (6) The phone displays a 'printing' animation, followed by a final result showing a grid of multiple small photos in a classic Purikura layout. (7) The woman returns to the frame, talking directly to the camera with a cheerful expression, holding her phone to the side.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced, high-energy electronic BGM with bright synthesizer leads begins. A female voice speaks with high arousal and a cheerful tone. (2) A sharp 'pop' and 'click' digital SFX are heard as a screen button is touched. (3) A distinct metallic 'clink' sound mimics a coin being inserted into a machine, followed by a short melody chime. (4) BGM continues with a steady 4/4 electronic beat. Additional digital 'selection' pings occur as frame options are scrolled. (5) A classic 'shutter click' SFX triggers when the photo is taken. (6) A rhythmic mechanical 'whirring' sound effect play, simulating a photo printer in action. (7) The main female voice continues to describe the experience with a laughing, friendly tone until the BGM fades out at the end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To introduce and demonstrate how to use a specific retro-style web application ('heisei-puri') that mimics Japanese 90s/00s sticker photo machines, targeting users interested in vintage aesthetics and photography apps.
